description: Pierce County, Washington publishes this geospatial resource. Coverage is the county or the specific subarea named below. The official constructed-trails inventory covers paved regional and soft-surface trails, with use, surface, width and length attributes. The native layer exposes polyline geometry and named attributes, including Property, TrailName, TrailClass, Users, Surfacing, Length_ft. It provides source-defined infrastructure geometry, constraints or measurements for network flow studies. It includes supplemental records from other recreation providers; coverage does not imply a uniform survey date or present accessibility. The public county catalogue advertises ArcGIS REST access and export descriptors such as GeoJSON, CSV and shapefile. Public metadata access was verified; no feature query or file download was performed. Reuse is subject to county terms linked by the provider; the PDF terms were not read, so no open licence or unrestricted reuse is assumed. Charges are not stated. Metadata modification dates do not establish observation dates, and a regular update schedule is not stated. No directly related active record was confirmed for this resource.
